LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_IND_ReconHelmet.label: light helmet
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_IND_ReconHelmet.description: Offers basic protection from the elements, gunfire and related shrapnel. Mainly utilized by support personnel. Should not be deployed against mechanized threats.
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_IND_ReconArmor.label: light suit
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_IND_ReconArmor.description: Offers basic protection from the elements, gunfire and related shrapnel. Mainly utilized by support personnel. Should not be deployed against mechanized threats.
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_IND_MarineHelmet.label: combat helmet
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_IND_MarineHelmet.description: A companion to the light line of suits, the combat variant offers better protection and durability for frontline combat. While it is decent for surviving suppressing fire, it will still buckle against large calibers and high explosives.

LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_IND_CataphractHelmet.label: heavy-duty helmet
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_IND_CataphractHelmet.descrip: The heavy-duty helmet is the heaviest of the heavy protection you can get before having to power the armor. Designed as bomb-squad protection minus the bulkiness, the heavy-duty helmet will survive most conventional threats.

LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_IND_CataphractArmor.descript: The heavy-duty suit is the heaviest of the heavy protection you can get before having to power the armor. Designed as bomb-squad protection minus the bulkiness, the heavy-duty suit will survive most conventional threats.

LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_AS_ReconHelmet.label: flanker helmet
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_AS_ReconHelmet.description: Light and agile powered helmet designed as combat replacement of the recon armors. In terms of protection, it's a marine armor with reduced weight and increased mobility.
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_AS_ReconArmor.label: flanker armor
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_AS_ReconArmor.description: Light and agile powered suit of armor designed as combat replacement of the recon armors. In terms of protection, it's a marine armor with reduced weight and increased mobility.
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_AS_MarineHelmet.label: vanguard helmet
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_AS_MarineHelmet.description: The mainstay of modern militaries outside of the rim. Offering a cataphract-level of protection without the induced mobility cost, Vanguard marines laugh in the face of danger.

LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_AS_CataphractHelmet.label: breacher helmet
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_AS_CataphractHelmet.descript: Space marine special used in combat deployments in the firey hell of space combat zones, Breacher helmets are used to get through PD cannon fire onto an enemy ship. They are heavy and hardly-penetrable.

LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_Ultra_Helmet.label: glitter helmet
LanguageData.ABT_Apparel_Ultra_Helmet.description: A helmet which is a part of the entire glitter armor set. It has no name in the rim, it does not exist in the rim, it's a myth. It's beyond an armored helmet; it temporarily fuses with the user to be able to perform tasks and protect the wearer. Protection offered by the set is unparalleled and unachievable for the common rimworlder.
